mintAuthority.summary: SILK is minted as an overcollateralized CDP via ShadeLend on Secret Network: vault contracts registered in the Shade Single Vault Registry mint SILK against DAO-whitelisted collateral, with risk parameters set by the ShadeLend Overseer. The SILK SNIP-25 token, ShadeLend Overseer, Vault Registry, Redemption Model, and Stability Pool all carry the ShadeDAO Multisig (secret1y277c499f44nxe7geeaqw8t6gpge68rcpla9lf) as their CosmWasm contract admin, which can register minters and migrate contract logic. Secret Network privacy prevents live verification of the current minter registry and multisig composition.

controls.label: Shade Single Vault Registry (ShadeLend CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: SILK mints only against overcollateralized, DAO-whitelisted vault deposits; per-vault debt and collateral parameters are governance-tunable through the Overseer and Admin Auth stack, so the effective mint ceiling is raiseable by governance.
controls.evidence: The SCRT Labs governance proposal for the Secret Network v1.10 upgrade (executed September 2023) lists the Shade Single Vault Registry at this address with the ShadeDAO Multisig as contract admin. Shade documents SILK issuance from vault contracts registered in this registry against overcollateralized user deposits. The current vault inventory and per-vault ceilings are private Secret Network state and cannot be enumerated from public reads.

controls.label: SILK SNIP-25 token contract
controls.capDescription: SNIP-25 token enforcing an admin-managed minter registry; the contract admin (ShadeDAO Multisig) can register or remove minters and migrate the token logic, so mint authority is raiseable by governance.
controls.evidence: The v1.10 hardcoded-admins proposal lists the SILK SNIP-25 token at this address (code id 877) with the ShadeDAO Multisig (secret1y277c499f44nxe7geeaqw8t6gpge68rcpla9lf) as its contract admin. As a SNIP-20/25 token, minting is restricted to registered minter contracts; the current minter set is private state and unverifiable from public reads.

controls.label: ShadeLend Overseer (vault risk parameters)
controls.evidence: The v1.10 proposal lists the ShadeLend Overseer at this address with the ShadeDAO Multisig as contract admin. The Overseer manages ShadeLend vault risk parameters (collateral whitelisting, collateralization and fee parameters) that bound CDP minting; its current parameter values are private state.

controls.label: ShadeDAO Multisig (Secret Network contract admin)
controls.evidence: The v1.10 hardcoded-admins proposal names this account "ShadeDAO Multisig" and assigns it as the CosmWasm contract admin of the SILK token, ShadeLend Overseer, Single Vault Registry, Redemption Model (secret1mk2yt0gywtz704439mkqzjmntj09r837vc73s3), Stability Pool (secret1wdxqz26acf2e6rsac8007pd53ak7n8tgeqr46w), Admin Auth, and the Shade oracle stack, explicitly to enable logic upgrades without state migration. On-chain re-derivation 2026-07-30 via the Secret Network LCD account endpoint (chain: secret, account_number 117105): the account pubkey is a cosmos.crypto.multisig.LegacyAminoPubKey with threshold 5 over 7 secp256k1 public keys, confirming a native 5-of-7 Cosmos SDK multisig; the signer identities behind those pubkeys are not publicly disclosed, consistent with ShadeDAO's SHD-elected assembly model. Native Cosmos multisig accounts have no Safe-style module/guard surface. Any subsequent admin changes to dependent contracts remain private Secret Network state, so profile confidence stays manual-review.

review.evidence: SILK is a basket-pegged overcollateralized CDP minted through ShadeLend vault contracts registered in the Shade Single Vault Registry, with risk parameters managed by the ShadeLend Overseer and every mint-critical contract (SILK SNIP-25 token, Overseer, Vault Registry, Redemption Model, Stability Pool, Admin Auth, oracle stack) administered by the ShadeDAO Multisig secret1y277c499f44nxe7geeaqw8t6gpge68rcpla9lf per the SCRT Labs Secret Network v1.10 hardcoded-admins governance proposal executed in September 2023. On-chain re-derivation 2026-07-30 (Secret Network LCD, Lavender.Five, account_number 117105) resolves that admin as a native Cosmos SDK LegacyAminoPubKey multisig with threshold 5 over 7 secp256k1 public keys; signer identities behind the pubkeys are undisclosed. CosmWasm admin migration lets that multisig replace mint-critical contract logic without state migration, so mint logic is governance-changeable. Shade documentation also describes bounded conversion minting and bond/arbitrage (AMO) mint access; the contract identities and current status of those additional mint paths are not publicly enumerable and are recorded as a residual uncertainty. Secret Network's privacy model prevents live reads of the minter registry and vault parameters, so reconciliation remains unknown and confidence is capped at manual-review. Mechanism boundary dating: the Secret Network ecosystem history dates the Shade/SILK mainnet launch to April 2023 and the Shade team's April 2023 hackathon documentation states ShadeLend was live on mainnet; implementationLaunchDate uses the conservative 2023-04 month-end.

review.sourceFreeRationale: Mechanism and admin structure established from Shade docs and the SCRT Labs v1.10 governance proposal; the ShadeDAO Multisig authority model is on-chain verified (5-of-7), but Secret Network privacy precludes live verification of the current minter registry, signer identities, and bond/arbitrage mint-path status.
